summary.result: Results from in-situ test and analysis indicate that the contaminant concentration ratio as initial one ( C/ $C_0$ ) increases as the radius ratio ( r/R) increases from the injection well, and also increases as the depth ratio ( z/ H) increases from the top of contaminated area.
summary.background: The elapse time needed to attain $50\%$ and $90\%$ clean up level ( $ t_{50},\;t_{90}$ ) increases as the radius ratio ( r/R) and the depth ratio ( z/ H) increase.
summary.method: As above results, the procedure of soil flushing in contaminated area using vertical drains makes progress from the top of injection well to the bottom of extraction well.
